name: Littlestone Dimension / Prefix-$k$ Littlestone Dimension
details: A prefix-$k$ shattered tree is an ordinary shattered Littlestone tree. For every fixed $k>1$, half-intervals give an unbounded separation; extending the notation to $k=1$ gives ordinary Littlestone dimension.
proof: The prefix-$k$ condition only restricts the coordinate labels allowed in an ordinary shattered Littlestone tree. Therefore $\mathrm L(\mathcal H)\ge\mathrm{PL}_k(\mathcal H)$ for every fixed $k>1$. Extending the notation to $k=1$ gives the vacuous constraint and the identity $\mathrm{PL}_1=\mathrm L$.
witness_verification: For every fixed $k>1$, the half-interval class has $\mathrm L=\Theta(\log n)$ and $\mathrm{PL}_k=1$. Extending notation to $k=1$ instead gives $\mathrm{PL}_1=\mathrm L$.
